reason: Integrates ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok subscriptions into DeepSeek Harness through OAuth or imported credentials, exposing provider models plus search and media-generation tools.

summaries.zh: 通过 OAuth 或已有凭据将 ChatGPT、Claude 和 Grok 订阅接入 DeepSeek Harness，并提供模型、搜索及图像和视频生成工具。
summaries.en: Connects ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok subscriptions to DeepSeek Harness through OAuth or imported credentials, providing models plus search, image-generation, and video-generation tools.

capabilities: OAuth authentication with ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok
Reads and stores provider credentials locally
Calls external LLM, search, image-generation, and video-generation APIs
Downloads and stores generated media files locally
